Manifest.Name: No Forced Cutscenes
Manifest.Description: In co-op, stops Ridgeside Village and Stardew Valley Expanded story cutscenes started by another player from teleporting you into them. Instead, the cutscene is saved and plays just for you the next time you go to that place. Each player who wants this needs it installed.
Manifest.Author: Daniel
